top_signals.title: Qatar Becomes Largest Buyer of U.S. LNG Amid Hormuz Crisis
top_signals.summary: In an extraordinary turn of events, Qatar, the world’s second-largest LNG exporter before the Iran war, will become the biggest buyer of liquefied natural gas from the United States, the producer that overtook the Gulf nation as top LNG exporter earlier this decade. This extraordinary turn of events is, of course, the result of the extraordinary disruption that the Iran war and the closure of the Strait of Hormuz inflicted on Qatar, the LNG producer whose expansion plans for the rest of this decade were rivaled only by the U.S. The war and…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Crypto PACs eye 2028 ‘new map’ as Democrats take Congress
top_signals.summary: Crypto super PACs spent more than $176 million on the midterms, but the Democratic sweep raises the prospect of tougher industry scrutiny.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
